name: Immich family photo TV screensaver script

mentions.name: Immich family photo TV screensaver script
mentions.description: This script finds random family photos in the Immich database, resizes them, overlays metadata such as where and when each picture was taken, and displays them on the TV as a screensaver while at home. It may also mix in Immich's "on this day" photos from past years, similar to Facebook's "Today 10 years ago" feature.
mentions.source_excerpt: A script which will find random pictures of anyone in the family from the Immich database, resize them and add metadata on them like where they were taken and when and put them on the TV to show as kind of a screen saver when we're at home.
